title: Secret Paths
about: Discovering the hidden routes, rooms, and shortcuts that made the State Fair feel like a second home.
description: This track explores the hidden side of the fairgrounds that only the crew really knew. Behind the crowds and public spaces were stairways, rooftops, backstage corridors, shortcuts, and quiet rooms that made up an entirely different world. Learning those secret paths became more than navigation—it was a sign that I was no longer just visiting. I had become part of the family that knew how the place truly worked.
lyrics: There's the fair that everybody sees,
Bright signs, crowds and midway screams.
A quieter world behind the scenes.
That the ticket holders never knew.
Than it ever looked from out in public view.
Through the 4-H building, around the wall,
Past a door that didn't look like much at all.
Up the stairs, beneath the seats,
Across the places hidden from the streets.
That the ticket holders never knew.
Than it ever looked from out in public view.
The green room waited like a borrowed den,
The light shelf held what we'd need again.
Backstage stairways twisted out of sight,
And every hidden corner came alive at night.
The fair could swallow almost anyone,
Traffic barely moving beneath the sun.
But Mama showed us where the fair split wide,
And ten short minutes put us on the other side.
That the ticket holders never knew.
Than it ever looked from out in public view.
Ours was built from stairs and rafters,
The hidden fair was teaching me
How hidden people find a family.
And once I learned them too,
I was one of those who knew.
